units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 127:4">Targ. Ps. CXXVII, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 58:4">Ib. LVIII, 4</cite> <he>מן מְעָן</he> (h. text <he>מרחם</he>).
Ib. XLIV, 26 מְעָנָא Ms. (ed. מַעיְנָנָא; h. text בטננו).—Mostly pl. מְעִין, מְעַיָּיא, מֵ׳, מֵי׳; constr. מְעֵי, bowels, intestines.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 25:22">Ib. XXV, 22</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 93a:6">Ḥull. 93ᵃ</cite> <he>ריש מעיא</he> the starting point of the (large) intestines.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 976:19">Yalk. ib. 976</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00884"><he>כַּנְתָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3:7">Lev. R. s. 3</cite> <he>בי מעיא</he> (some ed. <he>מֵעַיָּה</he>) the small bowels; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:19:4">Koh. R. to VII, 19</cite> [read:] <he>בנת מ׳</he>; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="M02139"><he>מַעֲיָנָא</he></cite>.
